findings: The process monitor corroborates the crash. The game reached resource reload after creating the GL context. The last logged major collection completed.

The retained trace includes an early WSI enqueue marker but no terminal signal or faulting instruction. This does not establish whether presentation, shader compilation, or another concurrent operation caused the crash.

The same instance again reached resource reload before the process monitor recorded a crash. Sodium is absent from the active resource list and Indigo registers. Controlify and Fabric API remain loaded.
The retained SIGSEGV records at address 0x8 show HotSpot selecting implicit-null continuations and resuming. The trace continues beyond them and does not establish a terminal fault.
No matching JVM fatal report or abort marker identifies the crash. The final GC entry and OpenGL native lookup lines establish proximity only.
